name: KNIFE DUELS [BETA]
desc:
KNIFE DUELS 🔪
Fast-paced knife combat with kill streaks, and exclusive skins.

Fight other players in 1v1 Duels, Free For All, and Teams to earn XP from kills and level up.
Earn coins with each level up that you can use to buy cases to unlock new knife skins.

Game Modes:
⚔️ 1v1 Duels
🔥 Free For All
👥 Team Duels

Progression:
⭐ Earn XP from kills
💰 Get coins when you level up
🎁 Open cases
🔪 Collect knife skins
📈 Build kill streaks

Prove your skill, grow your collection, and become one of the top duelists in the arena!

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite the game if you enjoy it!
